niche_preference_profile: This user most often prefers light or softly toned interfaces with cohesive purple/lavender accents, generous spacing, clear sectioned hierarchy, and simplified focused layouts. They consistently like readable high-contrast text, rounded cards/buttons, prominent but polished CTAs, and organized content broken into grouped sections or cards rather than dense continuous blocks. In some cases they also prefer richer information when it is clearly structured for scanning, but overall they reject clutter, harsh dark/neon treatments, mixed accent colors, and visually heavy or crowded compositions.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers light, airy, neutral or softly toned surfaces with cohesive purple/lavender accents; generally rejects very dark, harsh high-contrast, neon, or mixed-accent color schemes.
Prefers open whitespace, generous padding, airy composition, and lighter visual weight rather than cramped, tightly stacked, or crowded layouts.
Prefers strong hierarchy with clear titles, subtitles, section headers, grouped content, bullets/cards, and easy scanning over dense paragraphs, weak labeling, or competing elements.
Prefers screens with a single clear focal area, fewer competing panels, reduced clutter, and simplified composition rather than busy multi-panel or distraction-heavy layouts.
Prefers visible, emphasized primary actions and cleaner control patterns, especially larger or well-framed buttons with refined styling, over weak, missing, flat, or overly form-like actions.
Prefers rounded cards, pill buttons, soft outlines, gentle shadows, and overall softer component treatment instead of square, heavy, or sharp-edged UI elements.
Prefers high-contrast readable text, clear icons/illustrations, and visually legible content presentation over dim text, faint graphics, or low-clarity elements.
